caption: The drawing depicts two lace bonnets set against a muted grayish-brown rectangular background, bordered by a lighter, beige outer margin. The larger bonnet, positioned on the upper left side, occupies most of the composition; it is white or light gray, with a detailed lace pattern comprised of parallel diagonal lines and diamond-shaped mesh, and is adorned with two wide, trailing ribbons tied in a bow at its bottom left edge. The smaller bonnet, located towards the lower right, is similarly rendered in white or light gray lace with intricate mesh patterns, and it features two shorter ribbons tied in bows at the base. The image is monochromatic, using shades of white, gray, and beige throughout for both the bonnets and background.
title: Baby's Cap
